objective: Replace artificial-sounding Kingdom ambience and generic gameplay notification WAVs with offline, professionally authored CC0 fantasy music and dedicated event SFX on Android staging only.
chosenApproach: Vendored pinned CC0 recordings, asset manifest Git hash validation, focused audio lifecycle cleanup with local pool, never remote Rork preview audio.
preserveBehaviors: 39 individually-profiled staging Kingdom scenes and 13 characters from R9
Existing R8 Skia/Reanimated game feedback hooks

acceptanceChecks: All 12 source recordings present in branch with manifest SHA and size
Source and native/web TypeScript compile; audio runtime in installed staging APK
Music starts only on game focus, respects toggle, no playback after blur/background
Quick actions do not fall back to app message/notification sounds
Staging Android real device listening QA before OTA acceptance
productionBaselineEvidence: Nonproduction R9 staging source 8b2a08ed037e572b4afee2160777968c4535f077 and staging visual parent e15b91fb95742a63e7d5d1d664d15b087681f331; no assertion of live installed staging APK or production OTA.
selectionRationale: Use already-composed CC0 original game music and dedicated CC0 event sounds pinned to immutable Git blob hashes. Existing app notification WAVs are inappropriate as premium game feedback; no per-play network or paid synthesis.

Stream from unreliable Rork preview host (rejected; missing offline resilience and prior 404)
Ship author-made licensed CC0 recordings offline with bounded Expo audio players (selected)
